sections.title: Project Overview
sections.context: Introduces Pizzarte (Aveiro restaurant site) as a Next.js 16 App Router marketing site with no backend/CMS, its Gatsby-to-Next migration history, tech stack, and how to run/build it locally.

sections.title: Architecture & Design
sections.context: Explains the root layout to locale-scoped layout to page to PageShell/PageChrome composition chain, how generateStaticParams pre-renders every locale x menu-category combination, and how the Next 16 'use cache' directive (lib/cache.jsx, cacheComponents in next.config.js) caches message/content loading.

sections.title: Internationalization & Routing
sections.context: Covers the 4-locale (pt default/en/fr/es) routing table and MENU_CATEGORY_SLUGS in i18n/routing.jsx, the proxy.ts middleware that resolves locales, the locale-aware Link/useRouter wrappers, and how legacy Gatsby URLs are redirected — the site's most structurally load-bearing pattern.

sections.title: Frontend Architecture
sections.context: Documents the 32 components organized by original Gatsby domain (about/header/footer/menu/chess/contact/animation/popup/layout) that each fuse desktop+mobile into one responsive component via styled-components, plus the deliberate pattern of deferring gsap/anime/Swiper imports into effects or ClientOnly to avoid breaking Next 16 static prerendering.

sections.title: SEO, Structured Data & Static Generation
sections.context: Covers the schema.org JSON-LD builders (Restaurant, Organization, WebSite, Menu, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage) in lib/jsonld.js, the Seo.js metadata component, the sitemap/robots/llms.txt route handlers, and how generateStaticParams pre-builds every locale x page combination — a deliberately heavy focus area given the agency's own SEO/GEO/AIO methodology docs.

sections.title: Content & Media Pipeline
sections.context: Explains the CMS-free content model — all copy lives in messages/{locale}/*.json and the gallery in content/gallery.json (one-time WordPress extraction) — and the build-time image manifest pipeline that indexes public/images into lib/imageManifest.json for the Image.jsx component.

sections.title: Troubleshooting & FAQ
sections.context: Captures known gotchas specific to this codebase (Date.now()-reading libraries breaking PPR/static prerender, stale .repowiki content, i18n link rules, menu slug changes) and a summary of the phased Gatsby 5 to Next.js 16 migration for future contributors.
